html: Every side and every extra role has its own way to win. Find yours below. Your Role Briefing card says the same.

panels.name: Fascists
items: Hitler is elected Chancellor after the 3rd Fascist policy.
A Fascist-team player executes the Liberal Spy.

panels.name: Communists
items: Hitler is executed (together with the Liberals).

panels.name: Jester
items: The Jester is executed: the game ends and nobody else wins.

panels.name: Card-party roles
items: The party on their Party Membership card wins.

label: When Hitler is executed
html: Liberals, Communists and the Monarchist win together. A Bodyguard who is still alive dies instead, once, and the game goes on.
